WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT member.link_to_major, major.department, COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member 
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
  GROUP BY member.link_to_major, major.department
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.link_to_major, 
    step1.department, 
    step1.member_count,
    step1.member_count * 1.0 / step2.total_members as proportion
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step2.total_members IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
  step3.link_to_major,
  step3.department,
  step3.member_count,
  step3.proportion,
  step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as difference
FROM step3
JOIN step4 ON step3.department = step4.department
WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
